note: The session map's audit table (workflow/session_map.py, read only there). levers: the lever class each kernel class (data/kernel_classes.json) and each non-kernel row (copies, host) is closed by; a class not listed is `kernel`. realization: per lever class, measured history: what a lever of that class realized against the gap or projection an audit gave before it was built (ratio = realized / projected, each row cited, run folders under ~/storage/boltbeam-runs). A class's factor is the median of its rows' ratios, at most 1; a class with no row has no factor and its targets rank last. A new realized pair is a new row. z: the standard errors a difference must clear (the kernel ledger's checks use 3). calls: words in a host API call's name, per vendor, for the call counts the shape flags read. A row's `predicted` is the search/span-saving prediction (boltbeam span-saving: the stock run's measured trace wall minus the candidate's bench in-model time; in-model, so no factor applies to it) and `predicted_ratio` = realized / predicted. A span prediction needs no factor: on the R1-R3 batch (read after the method was written; the host-wait rule came after, moving R1 by 0.06 us) it predicted 0.193 ms a step against 0.180-0.193 realized, search-realization-20261119. The factor here (session_map's) still scales the audit's gaps, which are not span predictions. projections: levers projected but never built or measured in the model; they hold no ratio and give no factor until realized. predictions: the registrations written before a candidate is measured: the candidate's hash (so a prediction and a realization row join on it), the pass and shape it was made at (`at`, PASS:SHAPE), predicted_ms_step, when it was registered, its source. A registration is never rewritten and stays after the measurement. historic: true marks one written after its measurement (region_gdn_gate and concat-rows: written into this record on 2026-11-20, after their sessions were measured): it is never counted blind, and its row says historic. A realization row with `candidate` is written from a session-ab record, in numbers: measured_ms_step (mean and 95% t interval over the pairs), turns [used, of], the prediction it was held against (predicted_for, predicted_at, predicted_ms_step, `prediction`: registered and when, or typed at measure time), realized_over_predicted, `artifact` (the sha256 of what ran) and `session` (the sha256 of the session record). Its key is (candidate, measured_at, session); a candidate sits under one class. When the prediction is for another candidate, pass or shape the row is `void`: the measurement stays, no ratio. `regressed`: the arm got slower. `ratio` (measured / projected_ms_step) is null without a projection and on a void row; a row with no ratio is not in the class's factor, a regressed one (ratio below 0) is.
